page.overview:
Who is Samitsu Tamagowa?

She is a slim, pretty, hazel-eyed Arafellin, who wears bells in her dark, braided hair.

She had a commanding, overbearing manner and could be petulant when balked.

As a Healer, Samitsu does not care if she gets bloodied or messy.

Samitsu is 144 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as a novice and four years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
